instrument: Siril load + boxselect + stat (every per-box number is Siril's); in-house is the grid bookkeeping and the largest-all-covered-rectangle search
criterion: a box is COVERED when Siril Min on the Green layer is >= floor — the sibling-class sky floor, never mere non-zero, and never the worst channel (the low channel clips to zero on fully covered sky in this class)
cells_omitted: 4000 per-box records dropped deliberately, following the precedent of datasets/aug06/l1_work/coverage_frame_union.json: the grid is a local Siril run and scripts/qa/coverage_frame.py is shipped, so the evidence regenerates on demand — `python3 scripts/qa/coverage_frame.py web/results/aug06/stack_set-01+02+03_full_wcs.fit datasets/aug06/corner_work/coverage_grid_union.json --grid=80x50 --channel=Green`. What the cells were USED for is kept: the header-derived depth map's verification against them, in corner_quality.json (depth_map_verified_by_the_tool).

header_depth_cross_check.why: the header-derived member-footprint depth map is the DEPTH axis of the corner-quality measurement, so it is checked against this grid rather than asserted
header_depth_cross_check.reading: 0 disagreements on the covered side. The 130 are the footprint-edge band, where a 91 px box straddles a member boundary so its centre is outside while part of the box is covered.
